note: PRE-REGISTERED before any run (§15/A5). Every stochastic-exposed claim in REQUIRED_CLAIM_SET resolves to SAMPLING_REQUIRED (with a complete policy) or DETERMINISTICALLY_CLOSED_WITH_PROOF. N/thresholds are fixed HERE, not after seeing results (no run-until-green). The actual bounded run is a separate obligation (stochastic-sampling-run) that needs live provider calls = OWNER_MONETARY_SPEND_CEILING; this file is the machine-closable pre-registration.

envelope.MACHINE_PRE_REGISTERED_SAMPLING_ENVELOPE: ≤ 60 total provider calls across all classes per certification
envelope.separationFromOwnerSpend: This machine envelope is independent of OWNER_MONETARY_SPEND_CEILING; the owner sets the dollar ceiling, the machine sets the call bound.

secret-scan.deterministicProof: static bundle chunk-graph scan; no model in the loop — output is a pure function of the fetched assets (deployedSecretScan.ts).

calendar.criticalSingleFailureRule: any wrong-date or unreadable-write is an immediate NOT_PROVEN (not averaged)
calendar.independencePolicy: fresh session + varied relative-date phrasing per trial

whatsapp.criticalSingleFailureRule: any cruel/mocking or wrong-recipient output = NOT_PROVEN

temporal.passThreshold: 6/6 grounded-with-source OR honest-decline; zero fabricated freshness

replacement-paths.independencePolicy: distinct utterances + fresh audio each trial

historical-corpus.deterministicProof: each historical escape replays through a deterministic detector oracle (RC_HISTORICAL_CORPUS.json); model variance cannot reopen a closed escape because the detector, not the model, decides closure.
